subtypes: Large-artery atherosclerosis n=132, Small-artery disease n=141, Cardio-embolic n=127
design: prevalent stroke patients (case-only, no within-cohort healthy controls — needs external healthy reference)
analyst_note: Largest stroke methylation cohort in GEO. Multi-subtype. Spanish (Soriano-Tárraga BasicMar lineage). Raw IDAT confirmed in suppfile.
pros: Largest single cohort. Multi-subtype within-cohort (large-artery atheroscl vs small-artery vs cardio-embolic). Raw IDAT.
cons: Case-only — no within-cohort healthy controls; would need cross-cohort healthy baseline (CHK-3.2 risk). HM450K.
CHK_3_1_concern: IDAT path → safe with raw EPIC threshold default (extreme >30%); HM450K platform threshold TBD (needs calibration VAL per CCL-041).
recommended_VAL_design: WITHIN-COHORT subtype contrast (large-artery vs small-artery vs cardio-embolic) — uses every patient as their own population, no external healthy needed for the primary contrast. Cross-cohort healthy from Italian buffy coat anchor for orientation only.

platform: EPIC v1.0 (850K) + HM450K (some samples on legacy)
subdomains: HTN (cohort with hypertension prevalence; needs phenotype file)
subtypes: NA — cohort-level cardiovascular phenotypes (BP, HTN status, related)
analyst_note: GENOA = Genetic Epidemiology Network of Arteriopathy. Largest single cohort by 2x. African-American only (high HTN prevalence). Substantial cardiovascular phenotyping in linked phenotype file.
pros: Largest cohort (n=1218). Population-based (Jackson MS). EPIC v1 + HM450K. African-American = high HTN-related cardiovascular event burden. Public Tier 1 supp.
cons: No raw IDAT in suppfile (TXT only — likely processed betas). Single ancestry. Phenotype file separate from methylation matrix.
CHK_3_1_concern: TXT-only suppfile = processed/normalized output likely. HIGH RISK of CCL-040-style deferral — needs verification before scoring.
recommended_VAL_design: PROBABLY DEFER per CCL-040 unless raw IDAT can be obtained; verify supp content before locking. If raw IDAT exists in BioProject PRJNA130945 or GENOA dbGaP arm, this becomes the largest possible cohort.

design: post-event longitudinal: NIHSS at baseline vs discharge (ΔNIHSS) — outcome stratified
analyst_note: Soriano-Tárraga 2022 — the EXOC4/MERTK paper. Post-event recovery design (good for "what does cell do during/after stroke"). Both HM450K and EPIC.
pros: Raw IDAT confirmed in supp. Both platforms — direct platform-CHK-3.1 calibration opportunity. EpiDISH cell-type analysis already published in source paper.
CHK_3_1_concern: IDAT path; mixed platform — needs separate per-platform CHK-3.1 thresholds (raw-EPIC default for EPIC arm; HM450K platform threshold still TBD).
recommended_VAL_design: Outcome-stratified: poor outcome (mRS>2 at 3mo) vs good outcome — within-cohort case/control. Direct comparison to GSE69138 multi-subtype design. Could ALSO serve as the TCGA-HM450 calibration cohort if we go that route.

subdomains: Mixed CVD risk-factor (depression as CVD risk factor)
design: prevalent psychiatric, but CHD/MI risk-factor relevant
analyst_note: NOT primary cardiovascular — Max Planck depression cohort. Listed because depression is known CVD risk factor. SHOULD NOT be a cardio-epic primary VAL but useful as a healthy-control reference (the 209 controls).
pros: 209 healthy controls with raw IDAT, 450K. Useful as cross-cohort healthy reference per CHK-3.2.
cons: Cases are psychiatric not cardiovascular — cannot be primary cardio-epic VAL.
recommended_VAL_design: NOT for primary cardio-epic. Could supply healthy controls for cross-cohort calibration.

analyst_note: Newborns with complex CHD requiring neonatal cardiac surgery — radically different cohort. Buccal swab not blood. PedBE epigenetic age clock used in source paper. Not adult cardiovascular.
pros: Pre-event design (CHD detected at birth). Recent. Both EPIC versions.
cons: Newborn population (N/A for adult cardiovascular biology). Buccal swab substrate — different from adult deployment substrate.
recommended_VAL_design: Optional — pediatric arm with separate H_min calibration. NOT primary adult cardio-epic.

breakdown: iPAH n=11 + heritable PAH n=10 + controls n=18
analyst_note: Endothelial-cell-specific methylation in PAH. Cultured PECs not whole blood — direct cell-of-origin signal.
pros: Cell-of-origin substrate (endothelial). Raw IDAT. PAH is hypertension subtype.
cons: Small (n=39). Cultured cells (not patient blood). Pulmonary not systemic HTN.
recommended_VAL_design: Stage 2 cell-of-origin VAL — direct test of EpiSCORE HeartRef EC tile + Loyfer Vascular_endothelial_cells tile against actual endothelial cell methylation in disease. Sets up vascular-endothelial-disrupted reference for cardio-epic Stage 2.

breakdown: 6 normal aorta + 12 aortic dissection + 6 bicuspid aortic valve with aortic dilation
analyst_note: Vascular tissue (ascending aorta) — direct cell-of-origin signal. Small but uniquely valuable for vascular tile validation.
pros: Cell-of-origin substrate (aortic tissue). Raw IDAT. Multi-subtype (dissection vs BAV+dilation vs normal).
recommended_VAL_design: Stage 2 cell-of-origin VAL on aortic tissue — direct test of EpiSCORE HeartRef SMC + Caggiano endothelial markers + Loyfer Vascular_endothelial tile.
